title: Introduction
description: What meilisearch-cdc is, how snapshot-then-stream change data capture into Meilisearch works, the core concepts and the feature overview.

title: Quick start
description: Download meilisearch-cdc, verify the checksum, start it, create the admin account and sync your first table into Meilisearch in five minutes.

title: Install the binary
description: Install the meilisearch-cdc binary on Linux (systemd), macOS (launchd) or Windows (service or terminal) with a dedicated user and data directory.

title: Docker and Compose
description: Run meilisearch-cdc in Docker: image tags, the /data volume, the non-root user, environment variables, secrets files and the Compose demo stack.

title: Kubernetes
description: Deploy meilisearch-cdc on Kubernetes with a single-replica Deployment, a PersistentVolumeClaim and Secrets mounted through the *_FILE variables.

title: Reverse proxy and TLS
description: Put meilisearch-cdc behind nginx or Caddy with TLS: Server-Sent Events settings, CDC_TRUST_PROXY, CDC_COOKIE_SECURE and CDC_PUBLIC_URL.

title: Backups and upgrades
description: Back up the meilisearch-cdc data directory and secret key, restore it, and upgrade the binary or the Docker image safely.

title: Configuration reference
description: Every meilisearch-cdc flag and environment variable with its default, the *_FILE secret variants, single-instance mode, logging, pprof and metrics.

title: Declarative tasks file
description: Define meilisearch-cdc sync tasks in a YAML or JSON file applied at startup (CDC_TASKS_FILE), with ${VAR} expansion for credentials.

title: Sources and connectors
description: The eleven change data capture sources supported by meilisearch-cdc, how connectors store credentials, and what every source has in common.

title: PostgreSQL
description: Capture PostgreSQL changes with logical replication (pgoutput): wal_level, REPLICA IDENTITY, replication slots, publications and grants.

title: MySQL and MariaDB
description: Capture MySQL 8 and MariaDB changes from the binary log: binlog_format=ROW, binlog_row_image=FULL, server ids, grants and positions.

title: MongoDB
description: Capture MongoDB changes with change streams on a replica set or sharded cluster: connection string, _id handling, resume tokens and drops.

title: DynamoDB
description: Capture Amazon DynamoDB changes through DynamoDB Streams with NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES: credentials, IAM permissions, shards and 24h retention.

title: CouchDB
description: Follow the CouchDB or Cloudant _changes feed into Meilisearch: connection URL, database permissions, deletes, design documents and sequences.

title: SQL Server
description: Capture SQL Server changes from native CDC change tables: sp_cdc_enable_db, sp_cdc_enable_table, SQL Server Agent, grants and retention.

title: CockroachDB
description: Capture CockroachDB changes with a core changefeed: kv.rangefeed.enabled, CHANGEFEED privilege, HLC positions and gc.ttlseconds.

title: Kafka (Debezium)
description: Consume Debezium change events from Kafka with the JSON converter to sync Oracle, Db2, Cassandra and other databases into Meilisearch.

title: Redis Streams
description: Push changes into a Redis stream with XADD and sync them into Meilisearch: entry format, op field, positions and trimming.

title: SQL polling
description: Poll any PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite table with an incrementing cursor column when log-based capture is not available; soft deletes and limits.

title: Webhook (HTTP push)
description: Push changes to meilisearch-cdc over HTTP: the /api/v1/ingest endpoint, JSON, array and NDJSON payloads, responses and retries.

title: Meilisearch destinations
description: Add Meilisearch instances as destinations: URL, API key permissions, gzip, timeout, health checks, the default destination and per-instance pages.

title: Create a task
description: Every field of a meilisearch-cdc task, step by step through the wizard: source scope, mapping, primary keys, index, write mode, sync and safety.

title: Operate tasks
description: Task states and lifecycle actions (start, pause, resync, reset checkpoint), editing, batch actions, import and export, and the task detail tabs.

title: Index management
description: Manage Meilisearch index settings from meilisearch-cdc: the settings editor, drift detection, primary keys, swap, compaction, search and documents.

title: Data quality
description: Check that Meilisearch matches the source: schema check, document diff and repair, and the dead letter queue with replay and discard.

title: Monitoring and metrics
description: Monitor meilisearch-cdc: the live dashboard, Server-Sent Events, Prometheus metrics with names and labels, health endpoints and logs.

title: Alerts and notifications
description: Alert rules (task state, lag, dead letters, errors, stalled, Meilisearch down) delivered by email (SMTP), Telegram or webhook.

title: Team and security
description: Roles and the permission matrix, invitations, password reset, the primary administrator, sessions, CSRF, rate limiting, audit log and secret encryption.

title: AI agents (MCP)
description: Let AI assistants manage meilisearch-cdc over the Model Context Protocol: enable /mcp, create tokens, configure clients, tools, resources and policy.

title: Admin CLI
description: The meilisearch-cdc admin operator CLI: users, sessions, MCP and purge commands, socket and direct modes, and recovery recipes.

title: Mobile and app install
description: Install the meilisearch-cdc dashboard as an app on desktop or phone, how it behaves offline, and how updates are applied.

title: REST API
description: The meilisearch-cdc REST API v1: authentication, errors, tasks, data quality, indexes, destinations, connectors, accounts, alerts and live events.

title: Performance and tuning
description: Measured meilisearch-cdc throughput, memory sizing, batch size, in-flight batches, gzip, GOMEMLIMIT and GOGC tuning, and profiling with pprof.

title: Troubleshooting and FAQ
description: Fix common meilisearch-cdc errors: replication slots, binlog settings, replica sets, SQL Server Agent, safety holds, SMTP TLS and 409 conflicts.

title: Changelog and upgrade notes
description: Where to find meilisearch-cdc release notes, Docker image tags and the upgrade checklist and notes to read before moving between versions.

title: Development
description: Build meilisearch-cdc from source, run unit, integration, end-to-end and dashboard tests, the full GUI e2e environment and load tests.
